content.short: DeepDAO provides discovery and analytics for the DAO ecosystem.
content.description: DeepDAO aggregates and analyzes financial and governance data across thousands of DAOs and millions of governance token holders and voters. Its flagship dashboard catalogs and ranks DAOs using core indicators like member counts and assets under management (AUM), offering clear comparisons and insights. DeepDAO data is relied on by a broad community, including leading research firms such as Delphi Digital and Messari, journalists, venture capitalists, protocol policymakers, and DAO enthusiasts throughout the ecosystem.
